title: Riga pickets in support of Alexei Navalny
reason: The reported demand was solidarity with Russian protesters and Navalny’s release, directed toward Russia; no demand to Latvia or Latvian policy appears in the opened report. In addition, reported participation is cumulative over several hours and the report says single-person pickets rotated, so at least 50 people concurrently are not evidenced.
notes: LSM says Latvijas Radio estimated at least 50 participants and other observers estimated hundreds over several hours. Preserve those attributions as total participants, not simultaneous attendance. Riga's executive director reportedly did not authorize the planned rally due to COVID restrictions; this is not coded as dispersal. Police observed and urged compliance by loudspeaker; the source does not report an attempt to move/break up the pickets. The actual gathering is dated 23 January, not just announced.

title: Daugavpils action in support of Alexei Navalny
reason: The parent report describes an analogous action in support of Navalny, directed toward Russia; no Latvia-directed demand is evidenced. Concurrent crowd size is unknown.
notes: Kept separate from the Riga picket because the source identifies a second city but does not document coordination, participants, time or a unit boundary. Linked full article was not opened; no size or state response inferred.
